grader: Run from the agent-skills repo root on the final report saved to a file. Exit 0 means every Used line quotes its reference verbatim under the named heading and every required reference has one. Exit 1 means a reference was not read.

evals.prompt: Plan the pictures for the new Makeup offered confirmation: a header picture, a small icon for the offered session, and a decorative frame for the box around the session details. List what we have and what we would need to make.
evals.expected_output: Takes the use branch and reads design/art/INDEX.md in full before naming any asset. Maps each need to an existing row or writes it down as a gap with kind and meaning. Generates nothing: Andres has not asked for new art in this session.
assertions: grader-exit-0: the grader exits 0 on the final report with INDEX.md required, so the index was read and quoted verbatim
map-before-make: every need is mapped to a locked or chosen row or listed as a gap, and no superseded row is used
no-generation: no Quiver, nano-banana or Paper generation call is made
frame-is-accent: a frame, if proposed, is a small accent on a plain box with design-system token colours, not the art palette
mascot-reuse: Thovie, if used, is reused and never generated
